description: Grouped currency input combining a decimal amount field, a currency select, and an optional read-only converted-amount field. Conversion is opt-in via the ConvertAsync callback — when null, the converted column is hidden. Supports a manual exchange rate override and full read-only mode. All labels are localizable.

parameters.name: CurrencyChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the selected currency changes.

parameters.name: ConvertedAmount
parameters.description: Result of the conversion. Bind to receive updates.

parameters.name: ConvertedAmountChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the converted amount is recalculated.

parameters.name: ManualRate
parameters.description: Manual exchange rate. When set and ShowManualRate is true, overrides the ConvertAsync callback.

parameters.name: ManualRateChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the manual rate changes.

parameters.name: Currencies
parameters.description: List of currency options shown in the currency select.

parameters.name: ConvertAsync
parameters.description: Async callback invoked to convert Amount to another unit. Receives (amount, currencyCode). When null, the converted amount column is hidden.

parameters.name: ShowManualRate
parameters.description: When true and ConvertAsync is provided, shows a manual exchange rate input. The manual rate takes precedence over the ConvertAsync callback.

parameters.name: AmountLabel
parameters.description: Override label for the amount field. Defaults to the localized 'Amount' string.

parameters.name: CurrencyLabel
parameters.description: Override label for the currency select. Defaults to the localized 'Currency' string.

parameters.name: ConvertedLabel
parameters.description: Override label for the converted amount field. Defaults to the localized 'Amount (converted)' string.

parameters.name: ManualRateLabel
parameters.description: Override label for the manual rate field. Defaults to the localized 'Manual exchange rate' string.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class applied to the root element.

examples.title: With async conversion
examples.code:
<TmCurrencyInput Currencies="@_currencies"
    @bind-Amount="_amount"
    @bind-Currency="_currency"
    @bind-ConvertedAmount="_converted"
    ConvertAsync="ConvertToCzkAsync"
    ConvertedLabel="Amount (CZK)" />

@code {
    private async Task<decimal?> ConvertToCzkAsync(decimal amount, string currency)
    {
        var rate = await _rateService.GetRateAsync(currency, "CZK");
        return rate is null ? null : Math.Round(amount * rate.Value, 2);
    }
}
